answer: Work-history passport: a new agent starts on the lowest terrace with read-only access and must finish 30 days of verifiable useful tasks — signed API jobs, never self-issued claims — before it can transact. Each task adds a stamp; a missed week drops it a tier, and old stamps echo forward, so a fresh clone inherits no reputation. One credible passport costs 720 hours of real compute plus $450 in task fees, so 100 fakes burn $45,000 and a full month for no shortcut. Like a terraced hillside, each level must be climbed in order — no elevator lifts a signal that has not earned its height.
